title: Print Dialog Defaults — Duplex, Copies & Page Range

blocks.text: This document carries layout.viewerPreferences (pdfnative 1.7.0 print-dialog keys). Open the print dialog in a conforming viewer and the defaults below are pre-selected — purely presentational, PDF/A-safe hints the user can still override.
Page 2 — included in the default print range

The /PrintPageRange entry uses inclusive 1-based pairs in the JSON ([[1, 2]] here) and is written 0-based to the PDF. Viewers honour /NumCopies values from 2 to 5 (ISO 32000-1 Table 150); other values are ignored.
